The presence of a T2-FLAIR mismatch ('T2-FLAIR Mismatch Present': 1.0) is a well-established imaging biomarker for gliomas of the astrocytic lineage (1p/19q non-codeleted) and is characteristically absent in oligodendrogliomas (1p/19q codeleted). Other features such as the temporal lobe location and lack of enhancement are non-specific and can be seen in both subtypes. overall_comment: The imaging findings are highly characteristic of a low-grade, IDH-mutant astrocytoma. The definitive T2-FLAIR mismatch sign strongly supports both IDH-mutant and 1p/19q non-codeleted status. The complete absence of enhancement or necrosis favors a CNS WHO grade 2, although the large tumor volume introduces some uncertainty regarding grade. Overall, the most probable diagnosis is Astrocytoma, IDH-mutant, CNS WHO grade 2.
